pois.intro: Osaka Castle is a Japanese castle in Chūō-ku, Osaka, Japan. The castle is one of Japan's most famous landmarks and played a major role in the unification of Japan during the sixteenth century of the Azuchi–Momoyama period.

pois.intro: The Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan is an aquarium located in the ward of Minato in Osaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan, near Osaka Bay. When it opened in 1990, it was the largest public aquarium in the world.

pois.intro: The Amagasaki derailment occurred in Amagasaki, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan, on 25 April 2005 at 09:19 local time, just after the local rush hour.

pois.name: Super Nintendo World / スーパー・ニンテンドー・ワールド
pois.intro: Super Nintendo World is a themed area at Universal Studios Japan, Universal Studios Hollywood and Universal Epic Universe. A result of a partnership between Nintendo and Universal Destinations & Experiences, the area is based on Nintendo video game franchises, primarily the Mario and Donkey Kong franchises.

pois.name: 国立国際美術館
pois.nameEnglish: The National Museum of Art, Osaka
pois.intro: The National Museum of Art, Osaka is a subterranean Japanese art museum located on the island of Nakanoshima, located between the Dōjima River and the Tosabori River, about 10 minutes west of Higobashi Station in central Osaka. The official Japanese title of the museum translates as the "National Museum of International Art".

pois.name: 大阪城公園
pois.intro: Osaka Castle Park is a public urban park and historical site situated at Osaka-Jō in Chūō-ku, Osaka, Japan. It lies on the south of the Ōkawa and occupies a large area in the center of the city of Osaka.

pois.name: 天王寺公園
pois.intro: The Tennōji Park is a park with botanical garden at 1–108, Chausuyama-cho, Tennōji-ku, Osaka, Japan.

pois.name: 天王寺動物園
pois.intro: Tennōji Zoo is a 11-hectare zoo located at Tennōji Park in Tennōji-ku, Osaka, Japan, opened on January 1, 1915. It is the third zoo to be built in Japan and is located southwest of the Shitennō-ji temple, the first Buddhist temple in Japan.

pois.name: 大阪市立美術館
pois.openingHours: Tu-Su 09:30-17:00; 2022 Sep 26-2025 Feb 28 closed "closed due to renovation"
pois.intro: The Osaka City Museum of Fine Arts is a museum located in Tennōji Park, Tennōji-ku, Osaka, Japan. The museum focuses on Japanese and east Asian art.

pois.name: 大阪市立科学館
pois.intro: The Osaka Science Museum is a science museum in Naka-no-shima, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan. The museum is located between the Dōjima River and the Tosabori River, above Osaka's subterranean National Museum of Art.

pois.name: 尼崎城
pois.intro: Amagasaki Castle was a flatland type Japanese castle located in the city of Amagasaki, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. The castle was the headquarters of Amagasaki Domain, which ruled this portion of northern Settsu Province under the Tokugawa shogunate of Edo Period Japan.

pois.name: 大阪歴史博物館
pois.intro: Osaka Museum of History opened in Chūō-ku, Ōsaka, Japan, in 2001. The project architects were César Pelli & Associates and Nihon Sekkei.

pois.name: 湯木美術館
pois.intro: Yuki Museum of Art opened in Chūō-ku, Osaka, Japan, in 1987. The collection, built up by Yuki Teiichi of kaiseki restaurant Kitchō fame, includes twelve Important Cultural Properties and three Important Art Objects.

pois.name: 大阪人権博物館
pois.intro: Liberty Osaka was a museum dedicated to human rights situated in Naniwa-ku, a ward in south Osaka City.

pois.name: 天保山大観覧車
pois.intro: Tempozan Ferris Wheel is a 112-meter-tall Ferris wheel located in Osaka, Japan, at Tempozan Harbor Village, next to Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan, one of the largest aquariums in the world. The wheel has a height of 112.5 metres and diameter of 100 metres.

pois.name: あべのハルカス美術館
pois.intro: Abeno Harukas Art Museum opened in Abeno-ku, Ōsaka, Japan, in 2014. Specializing in temporary exhibitions, it is located on the 16th floor of Abeno Harukas, Japan's tallest building, named after the ward of Abeno and the expression harukasu, meaning 'brightening up'.

pois.name: Despicable Me: Minion Mayhem
pois.intro: Despicable Me Minion Mayhem is an animated simulator ride attraction located at five amusement parks: Universal Studios Florida, Universal Studios Hollywood, Universal Studios Japan, Universal Studios Beijing, and Universal Studios Singapore. The attraction is based on Universal Pictures and Illumination's animated film Despicable Me and its franchise.

pois.name: 大阪中之島美術館
pois.intro: Nakanoshima Museum of Art, Osaka opened in Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan in 2022. The museum is located in the central Nakanoshima district of Osaka.

pois.intro: Space Fantasy – The Ride is a spinning roller coaster at Universal Studios Japan in Osaka, Japan. The ride opened on March 18, 2010, as a replacement for the E.T. Adventure dark ride.

pois.intro: Sumiyoshi Park is an Osaka prefectural park in Hamaguchi-higashi Itchome, Suminoe-ku, Osaka, Japan. It was registered by Osaka Prefecture in 1873 with Hamadera Park in Nishi-ku, Sakai, and is the oldest park in Osaka.

pois.name: ハルカス300
pois.intro: ハルカス300は、大阪府大阪市阿倍野区にある展望台。あべのハルカスの58階から60階に位置する。

pois.name: 南港中央公園
pois.intro: 南港中央公園（なんこうちゅうおうこうえん）は、大阪府大阪市住之江区南港東にある総合公園。別称は南港BTB。

pois.name: 靱公園
pois.intro: Utsubo Park is a large public, urban park, situated at Utsubo-Hommachi in Nishi-ku, Osaka, Japan. The park was constructed at the site of a former air field of the United States Army, so the land is a long rectangle shape characteristic of a runway.

pois.name: 大阪市立長居植物園
pois.intro: The Nagai Botanical Garden is a botanical garden located in the southern part of Nagai Park, Higashisumiyoshi-ku, Osaka, Japan. An admission fee is charged for adults, while middle school students and under are free.

pois.name: 新大阪郵便局
pois.intro: 新大阪郵便局（しんおおさかゆうびんきょく）は、大阪府大阪市此花区にある郵便局である。2007年（平成19年）10月1日から2012年（平成24年）9月30日までは郵便事業新大阪支店だった。

pois.name: 大阪港郵便局
pois.intro: 大阪港郵便局（おおさかみなとゆうびんきょく）は、大阪府大阪市港区にある郵便局。民営化前の分類では集配普通郵便局であった。

pois.name: ミニオン・ハチャメチャ・アイス
pois.wikipedia: ja:ミニオン・ハチャメチャ・アイス
pois.intro: ミニオン・ハチャメチャ・アイス（英: Freeze Ray Sliders）は、ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパンの「ミニオン・パーク」に設置されている、『怪盗グルーシリーズ』をテーマとしたライド・アトラクションである。 2018年6月30日に、ミニオン・パークにおける2つ目のライド・アトラクションとして開業した。

pois.name: キッザニア甲子園
pois.intro: KidZania is a Mexican privately held international chain of indoor family entertainment centers currently operating in 30 locations worldwide, allowing children to role play adult jobs and earn currency. It receives at least 9 million visitors per year.
